title: Manual Frame Acquisition Schema
description: Metadata for driving the manual frame acquisition UI in the web application.

id.description: Unique ID for the acquisition section (e.g., 'usa-sheet').

label.description: Display label for the accordion trigger.

url.description: Direct URL to the image asset.

stem.description: Sanitized stem to use for the frame sheet.

storage.description: Which local storage category to use for these frames.
